slides.sub: Record once on Monday. Post daily until Sunday.

slides.title: One source, many cuts.
slides.sub: A single 10-minute answer holds a week of short posts.

slides.title: Record one answer.
slides.sub: Pick the question your audience asks most. Answer it on camera. No script, just this card:
slides.prompt:
1. The question, in their words.
2. Three points, one line each.
3. One real example.
4. What to do next.

slides.title: Find the best moments.
slides.sub: Paste the transcript into any AI chat with this prompt:
slides.prompt: Here is my video transcript. Find the 5 strongest moments. For each one, give me the start time, the end time and a one-line hook under 10 words.

slides.title: Cut the clips.
slides.sub: Trim each moment to 20 to 40 seconds and add captions.

slides.title: Your week, mapped.
items: A short clip with the strongest hook.
A quote card from the best line.
A carousel of the steps you explained.
The full video, with a question in the caption.

slides.title: Record once. Post all week.
slides.sub: Get the prompt and the week plan from {name}.

caption:
One 10-minute video can fill a whole week of posts. Record one answer, pull the 5 best moments with a single prompt, cut them into clips, and spread them across the week with a quote card and a carousel in between. Save this so you have the prompt and the plan next time. Which day would you post the full video?
